description: Physical wet-strip/electrostatic-generator experiment at open-circuit equilibrium: five equal nonzero foil-pair openings; generator right electrode earthed, wood left end NOT earthed. Preserve all supports, electrodes and mechanical apparatus.

authoritativeText.text:
要在物质中产生和维持电流，首先必须有**能够自由移动的带电粒子**。
如果正、负电荷束缚在原子或分子中，随同整个中性原子或分子一起移动，就不能形成这里讨论的传导电流。

仅有自由电荷还不够。
要让带电粒子产生并维持有秩序的运动，也就是定向运动，还必须有**沿一定方向作用的力**。

电场会对带电粒子施加力，作用力满足$\vec{F}=q\vec{E}.$
通常，导体内部的电场正是使带电粒子产生并维持定向运动的原因。
在静电平衡时，导体内的自由电荷不再定向移动，内部电场为零；

不能把这个结论用于正在通电的普通导体。

在这里讨论的普通导体中，内部的电场对应着两端的电势差。
在导体状态保持不变时，维持不随时间改变的电势差，就能维持稳恒电流。
沿着电流方向，电势从一端的最大值逐渐减小到另一端的最小值。

下面用实验观察这种电势的变化。

把一根湿木条水平悬起，作为实验中的导体。
湿木条虽然导电能力不强，仍然能够导电。
在木条上固定一些金属箔，用金箔的张角比较各处相对于地的电势。

用静电起电机作电源，把它的一个电极接地，另一个电极接到木条的一端。
以下讨论取与木条相连的电极相对于地为正电势；
金箔张角只能反映电势的大小，不能区分正负。

木条的另一端不接地，此时电路没有闭合。
转动起电机的手柄，等电荷在木条上达到平衡后，可以看到各处金箔张开相同的角度（图167）。
这说明木条各处相对于地的电势相同。

木条虽然带了电，但没有沿木条持续流动的电流。
接着把木条的另一端也接地，并继续转动起电机的手柄。
因为大地能够导电，这个接法使电路通过大地闭合，起电机持续维持电流。

接地端的金属箔不张开，因为这一端的电势实际上等于地的电势；
连接用的金属导体上的电势降很小。
与起电机相连的一端，金箔的张角最大（图168）。

越远离起电机、越靠近接地端，金箔的张角就越小。
这组不同的张角显示，相对于地的电势绝对值向接地端减小。
在前述相连电极为正电势的条件下，带符号的电势也从起电机一端向接地端降低；

若相连电极为负电势，则带符号的电势向接地端升高。

inventory.description: One continuous suspended wet wooden strip. Both physical endpoints remain identifiable; this is not a battery/resistor abstraction.
Complete left source support: broad foot, upright, ball top and diagonal wood-end member. These are apparatus, not electrical earth connections.
Complete right source support: broad foot, upright, ball top and diagonal wood-end member. These are apparatus, not electrical earth connections.
Source position 1 from left, exactly two foil leaves. Same nonzero opening as the other four pairs. Numeric angle/length values are illustrative modern regularization, not source measurements.
Source position 2 from left, exactly two foil leaves. Same nonzero opening as the other four pairs. Numeric angle/length values are illustrative modern regularization, not source measurements.
Source position 3 from left, exactly two foil leaves. Same nonzero opening as the other four pairs. Numeric angle/length values are illustrative modern regularization, not source measurements.
Source position 4 from left, exactly two foil leaves. Same nonzero opening as the other four pairs. Numeric angle/length values are illustrative modern regularization, not source measurements.
Source position 5 from left, exactly two foil leaves. Same nonzero opening as the other four pairs. Numeric angle/length values are illustrative modern regularization, not source measurements.
All five foil pairs have equal nonzero openings in the open/equilibrium case. Independent semantic check additionally enforces exactly five two-leaf pairs.

Physical electrostatic generator: segmented circular disk and rim, hub, diagonal member, TWO separate ball-ended electrodes with separate arms, two jar-like vertical side assemblies with collars/inner rods, support uprights, lower double-ring wheel/hub, drive links, crank and platform. The scan does not supply exact sector count or mechanical measurements.

Coiled/wavy conducting lead from the actual RIGHT WOOD endpoint, over the right support, to the LEFT generator electrode. Every intermediate segment and both electrical endpoints are individually asserted.
Source RIGHT generator electrode connects down the right side to its own earth. Exact first and final endpoints and every wire segment are asserted.
One complete source earth termination: descending stem plus three successively shorter horizontal bars. Wire terminates at earth, not at a support or generator base.
